East London Strippers Collective host weekly life drawing classes upstairs at Filthy Fanny's on Mondays!
We honour the history of the Crown and Shuttle; an old school East-End boozer, where strippers entertained rowdy masses, alongside life music, comedians and other louche entertainment. Come draw breath-taking aerial pole poses, featuring a variety of gorgeous strippers from London, the UK and beyond!

Welcome to The Coal Hole, an historic pub ON THE STRAND
As a British brand with a heritage of 150+ years, we pride ourselves on our position as purveyors of perfect pints and unbeatable pies, with tempting dishes on our British pub classic menus.
A unique city centre pub with a rich history
Nicholson’s Pubs are known for their individual style, exciting stories, and charming personalities — and The Coal Hole one of a kind.
Rumour has it, The Coal Hole occupies what was once the coal cellar for the Savoy Hotel! In the Victorian era, the pub was a well-known 'song and supper' club where regulars were encouraged to sing comical songs and sentimental ballads.
Gilbert and Sullivan regularly performed here in Edwardian times, and the Shakespearean actor Edmund Keane started the Wolf Club here for oppressed husbands forbidden to sing in the bath!

You'll find Orbit Beers Brewery & Taproom tucked away in the heart of Walworth in South London, on the same site we began brewing in 10 years ago.
An open, welcoming space with both indoor & outdoor seating, regular Friday night DJs, Bring Your Own Vinyl - 2nd Friday of every month, and Spoken Word Night - 3rd Thursday of every month. The taproom and yard are family-friendly, dog-friendly, and wheelchair accessible.
Our back space can accommodate large groups of up to 40-50. Get in touch to book for your party.
Current Residency: The Dragon Flame BBQ
Sunday Roasts from Dragon Flame BBQ
We currently have The Dragon Flame BBQ team in the kitchen at the taproom. Offering burgers and tacos alongside an amazing Sunday roast.
Voted one of the best roasts in London by TimeOut . Served every Sunday from 1pm The roasts include crispy roast potatoes and oak-smoked mains served with seasonal vegetables, red braised cabbage, Yorkshire pudds & red wine jus. Make sure to book to avoid disappointment!

Ireland v Argentina
Ireland will take on Argentina at the Aviva Stadium in Dublin on Friday 6th November, during the fourth round of the 2026 Nations Championship.
In their most recent encounter, Ireland held on to beat the Pumas 22-19 during the 2024 autumn series.
Scotland v New Zealand
Scotland will face New Zealand at Scottish Gas Murrayfield on Saturday 7th November, during the fourth round of the 2026 Nations Championship.
In their most recent encounter, Scotland mounted a valiant fightback but ultimately fell short as the All Blacks claimed a 25-17 victory during the 2025 autumn series.
Wales v Japan
Wales will host Japan at the Principality Stadium in Cardiff on Saturday 7th November, during the fourth round of the 2026 Nations Championship.
In their most recent encounter, Wales snatched a dramatic 24-23 victory over Japan with a last-kick penalty during the 2025 autumn series.
England v Australia
England will tackle Australia at the Allianz Stadium, Twickenham on Sunday 8th November, during the fourth round of the 2026 Nations Championship.
The sides will compete for the Ella Mobbs Trophy, which was most recently awarded to England following their 25-7 victory over the Wallabies during the 2025 autumn series.
Wales v New Zealand
Wales will take on New Zealand at the Principality Stadium in Cardiff on Saturday 14th November, during the fifth round of the 2026 Nations Championship.
In their most recent encounter, Wales put up a decent fight but were beaten 52-26 by the All Blacks during the 2025 autumn series.
England v Japan
England will face Japan at the Allianz Stadium, Twickenham on Saturday 14th November, during the fifth round of the 2026 Nations Championship.
In their most recent encounter, England thrashed Japan 59-14 during the 2024 autumn series.
Ireland v Fiji
Ireland will host Fiji at the Aviva Stadium in Dublin on Saturday 14th November, during the fifth round of the 2026 Nations Championship.
In their most recent encounter, Ireland scored eight tries as they beat Fiji 52-17 during the 2024 autumn series.
Scotland v Australia
Scotland will tackle Australia at Scottish Gas Murrayfield on Sunday 15th November, during the fifth round of the 2026 Nations Championship.

Why book with The Admiralty, Trafalgar Square?
A great location, superb service and three fabulous floors offering endless possibilities - that's what makes The Admiralty one of the best places in Trafalgar Square for your next corporate event. We've been hosting corporate events here ever since we opened in 2014, so you can trust us to deliver an occasion that lives up to the highest expectations.
We can tailor our packages to suit your event, giving you a choice of dining options for your gathering. Our drinks packages are suitable for all types of events and simplify your booking journey, giving you more time to enjoy yourself.
Overview
The private dining room, The Admiral's Cabin, is the most exclusive area of the pub. The room offers seating for 14, together with full AV facilities - perfect for an exclusive dining experience or holding board meetings. This room is an opulent setting that can be adapted for private dining - the ideal place to wow your guests.

Pub history
Number 205 High Street is the former Greyhound public house. The building is set slightly back from the road and occupies the site of an earlier public house of the same name. A photograph of The Greyhound taken in 1873 shows a three-storey Georgian-style building with a large sign overhanging the pavement. The Greyhound was first recorded in 1797; this may well have been the year it was built.

Sunday roast in Covent Garden

From pints paired with bar snacks, pub classics and Sunday roasts, wines from around the world, and cocktails on the roof terrace we really do offer it all.
Our ground floor pub gives you everything a traditional pub should, with dark stained wood and leather seating, to our beautiful first floor lounge perfect for dining. And the jewel in the crown is our stunning roof terrace complete with retractable roof and windows allowing you views of the Covent Garden skyline and London’s Theatreland but still keeping you cosy on the chillier days.

Most London magicians do one skill. Think of me as the Swiss Army knife - sleight of hand, mind reading, pickpocketing, comedy. London Magician FAQ
How much does a magician in London cost? + A professional close-up magician in London typically starts from £500. The exact price depends on event type, guest numbers, time of year, and duration required. Saturdays and December are premium. I send a full pricing PDF the moment you enquire. For more detail, read my blog post on how much a close-up magician costs .
What areas of London do you cover? + All of London and Greater London. From Mayfair, Kensington, Chelsea and the City of London to Shoreditch, Canary Wharf, Richmond, Hampstead and the wider North London. Also covering Hertfordshire, Essex, Surrey and the Home Counties. Distance is never an issue - I perform across the entire UK. You can also find me on Google Maps .
Can you provide multiple magicians for large London events? + Yes. I lead a handpicked team of close-up magicians called The Close-Up Collective. For large London events with 150+ guests - especially at venues like The Shard, Tower Bridge, and the City - one magician isn't always enough. The team are all full-time professionals personally vetted by me.
How do I book a magician for my London event? + Fill in my online enquiry form with your date, venue, and rough guest numbers. I'll send a pricing PDF within hours. A small deposit locks in your date, and the balance is due eight weeks before the event.

Purpose
Our purpose is to create “proper pubs” in London. We are London residents, passionate about creating a welcoming place for the community, offering excellent food, a great choice of beers and great quality wines. We want to be homely with some elegance, fun but professional. We are passionate about what we serve and how we do it.
We operated the Duke of Wellington until its heart-breaking closure in March 2016. We decided to keep going and took over the Albert Arms in SE1 in June 2016, which has since become the community’s beloved local and a destination for its Sunday Roast and also great and affordable selection of wines.
In October 2020, we have reopened the Duke, after an extensive refurb. We are very proud to be here again and able to welcome you into a new Duke, which we hope will become part of your daily life.

Built by Isleworth Brewery in 1731, The London Apprentice is one of the capital's oldest and most storied pubs. Tucked into a curve of the Thames in Isleworth, this cherished retreat brims with tales and treasures from a bygone era, when the river was the lifeblood of London.
Savour the flavour of cask ales and fine wines from our outdoor seating area or cosy up inside and indulge in refined pub food classics. From hearty pies to a traditional Sunday roast, a comforting fish finger sandwich and our selection of perfect puddings, you can enjoy the taste of unforgettable British food as you share good times with loved ones in our historic pub. This warm and friendly pub, adorned with original claygate fireplace and features, enhanced by maritime relics and historical paintings, provides a feeling of being in a country pub while being in one of the world busiest and greatest cities. In the summer enjoy the beautiful award winning garden and food “al fresco”.
The Plume features a candlelit restaurant providing gourmet dishes as well as traditional pub favourites with an exciting choice of English and Continental Cuisine accompanied by an outstanding international wine list. Sunday afternoons see the best traditional Sunday Roasts served with fresh seasonal produce.
The Plume is listed in CAMRA’s good beer guide for the UK and we serve 4 real ales including Harvey’s Sussex Best Bitter, Adnams and two excellent guest beers. We also have an impressive range of draught lagers, Stowford Press cider and bottled beers.
HISTORY OF THE PLUME
The pub was built in 1691, and was ideally situated on the busy Dover Road as travellers left Greenwich. Coaches and carts would pass through the gatehouse of the Queen’s House (possibly paying a toll there) and on their left would be the perfect place to stop off before they headed towards Kent.

We have a beautiful mirrored restaurant here at the Plume of Feathers were you can sit and enjoy freshly prepared meals. We offer delicious snacks and light bites to a full fare menu.

The Prospect of Whitby is London's oldest riverside pub dating back to 1520. Its original flagstone floor survives and the pub also has a rare pewter-topped bar as well as old barrels and ships masts built into the structure. Most areas of the pub have spectacular views over the River Thames, including the beer garden and first floor balcony and terrace.

Pub history
Several Wetherspoon pubs have ‘moon’ in their name, linking them with the ideal pub described in detail by George Orwell. The highly regarded author named his fictional pub ‘Moon Under Water’. This one was purpose built as a branch of the Woolworths chain. It opened in early summer of 1939, serving a fast-growing suburb. Woolworths traded here at Varley Parade for 45 years, closing in 1984.

Pub Food That Works for Parties, Events & Celebrations
Planning a birthday, work event or celebration in Camden Town? The Gipsy Queen is built for it. We offer flexible private hire options and tailored food and drink packages, making party planning simple.
From casual buffet-style pub food to full event catering, everything is designed to keep guests fed, happy and ready for another round.It’s the kind of place where people don’t just host events — they remember them.
What makes the Gipsy Queen stand out is how everything connects. The pub food menu supports live sport, games, social spaces and events to create a venue people actively choose for occasions.
You can start with sourdough pizza and craft beer, move into darts or karaoke, catch live sport, and finish with desserts and cocktails — all without losing that independent, neighbourhood pub feeling Camden is famous for.

How do I keep my personal information private?
If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.
To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.
Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be fully updated within two days.

Christmas in Earlsfield
It’s that mince-pie-munching, Prosecco-popping time of year again, and Christmas in Earlsfield is officially on. Just across from Earlsfield Station (no sleigh required), our pub is twinkle-lit, holly-decked and ready with mulled wine, winter cocktails, craft beer and a hearty festive menu made for proper seasonal feasting.
From office Christmas parties and private dining to cosy family get-togethers and Christmas Day lunch, we’ve got candlelit corners, comfy booths and a fairy-lit conservatory ready for the occasion.
Our menu this winter is all about hearty and nostalgic plates made for long, leisurely grazing (and yes, perfect for sharing… or keeping all to yourself — we won’t judge). Think small plates made for the middle of the table and flavour-packed dishes that champion brilliant British farmers and producers – the kind of food that just tastes better in your favourite local.
Not in the mood to share? No problem. Tuck into generous, feel-good pub classics with an indulgent twist. And Sundays? Still sacred. Expect roast-after-roast with golden, crispy potatoes, succulent cuts, towering Yorkshires and proper, rich gravy.

Sundays at our pub are all about good vibes, great food, and red wine moments. Picture this: a buzzing atmosphere, a friendly team, and a cosy corner made for warming up while indulging in incredible roasts.
Whether you’re digging into our juicy, melt-in-your-mouth Rump of West Country beef, our mouth-watering Sutton Hubbard half chicken, our delicious vegan special, or the unbeatable Dingley Dell pork belly (it’s a crowd favourite, trust us), we’ve got something to satisfy every craving.
Pair it all with a rich red, a perfectly poured pint or a warming winter drink and you’ve got the ultimate cosy Sunday feast.

Located in the heart of Victoria, The Albert is your quintessential friendly British pub — with a twist of architectural grandeur. Despite being a bustling four storey pub, The Albert retains a spacious, accommodating atmosphere.
The busy borough of Westminster is a tourist haven, packed with plenty of sightseeing gems: from Buckingham Palace to Westminster Cathedral. Combine the cosy charm and world famous surroundings of The Albert with its offerings of real ale, quality food, Sky Sports TV, BT Sport and visitor Wi-Fi, and it's easy to see why so many take refuge here.

Nestled on the edge of Victoria Park, The Royal Inn on the Park blends spacious charm with a cozy, welcoming vibe. From families to tourists, foodies to locals, we offer something for everyone—a true gathering place to dine, drink, and unwind.
A home
At The Royal Inn on the Park, we believe a great pub is more than just a place to eat and drink. It’s a community hub, a space to relax, and a destination where unforgettable meals meet warm, friendly service.
Set against the stunning backdrop of Victoria Park, we’ve created an atmosphere that’s as cozy as it is spacious, offering the perfect escape for locals, families, and visitors alike. Whether you’re savoring our bold, sustainably crafted menu, enjoying a pint with friends, or making memories at one of our events, The Royal is your home away from home.
Get in touch

Dine with us.
Looking for the best Sunday roast in Hackney or East London? Welcome to The Royal Inn on the Park, where tradition meets innovation in a cozy, welcoming atmosphere. Whether you're craving a comforting Sunday roast, seeking the perfect spot for outdoor dining in East London, or planning a bespoke wedding or event, we’re here to make it unforgettable.
Sunday Roasts in East London
Sunday Roasts are now on their Summer Holidays, you’ll find smalls plates, snacks, the occassional gravy and our legendary flatbreads on our summer menu through May, June, July + August. Our legendary Sunday Roasts will return in September.
Outside Dining in East London
When the sun shines, there’s no better place than our beautiful outdoor space. Perfect for al fresco dining or hosting a corporate garden BBQ, our space offers a relaxed vibe with views of the Victoria Park—ideal for a summer gathering.
Sustainability and Quality Ingredients
Weddings and Events in Hackney
During the summer and throughout the year, we host weddings and events with tailored menus and exceptional service. While our kitchen may be closed for regular service on these special days, our team is always happy to assist. Call us at 0208 985 3321 for more information.
Stay Connected
For the latest updates, including special menus, events, and seasonal offerings, follow us on Instagram @royalinnonthepark.
Experience the best of pub dining in East London. Whether it’s for a Sunday roast, outdoor dining, or a special celebration, The Royal Inn on the Park is where great food and unforgettable memories come together.

The pub's name pays homage to the dock's historical link with the whaling industry in the 19th century. The Greenland Dock, which the pub over looks, was a hub for whaling vessels in the 17th century, with ships returning laden with whale oil and blubber. The Docklands as a whole were integral to London being a global trading hub, with the Port of London once being the largest in the world.
We offer our guests a connection to the area's maritime heritage amidst its modern evolution.Experience the warmth of our cosy interiors, and on sunny days soak up some rays from our large terrace. The perfect Bloody Mary
There’s a Bloody Mary, and then there’s a proper Bloody Mary. And at The Alex, we don’t do things by halves (especially on a Sunday).
We’ve teamed up The Pickle House Spiced Tomato Mix with Absolut Tabasco to create a punchy, savoury, gloriously spicy little number that’ll put a spring in your Sunday step.
Think sun-ripened tomato juice, pickle juice that’s been patiently infused for 12 weeks (good things take time), fresh horseradish and vegan Worcestershire sauce, all hand-blended in small batches. Add a fiery kick of Absolut Tabasco and you’ve got yourself one seriously good Bloody Mary.
Best enjoyed with a proper Sunday roast, good company and absolutely no plans to rush home.

On Tap Now

We're bringing out the big guns at Beer Merchants Tap this November.
On Saturday 7th November, we're cracking open two exceptional imperial stouts from Iowa's legendary Toppling Goliath Brewing Co. for a very special, one-off tasting.
Taking centre stage are Assassin 2023, one of the brewery's most sought-after barrel-aged stouts and Term Oil – Vanilla Pistachio Granola, a seriously indulgent stout packed with rich, decadent flavour.
For £20, your ticket gets you a 1/3 pint pour of each beer, giving you the chance to experience these two incredible releases side by side.
We'll also have a huge selection of other fantastic beers pouring throughout the event, so there's plenty more to explore, expect some big hitters from Cantillon!
There are just 100 tickets available, and once they're gone, they're gone. Don't miss your chance to get involved.

Situated between London Bridge and Tower Bridge on Tooley Street is The Shipwrights Arms, a classic English pub.
The Shipwrights was built in 1884 and is now a Grade 2 listed building with an original tiled mural of the 'Shipwrights' at work. The pub has been deliberately kept traditional in style retaining the rare central island bar offering a wide range of continental lagers and up to 6 real ales which are Cask Marque quality assured.
With 2 big screens in the main bar and 1 in the function room you can watch all of the main events from Sky Sports and ESPN. When the screens are off there's a juke box featuring over 30,000 tracks.
Fri & Sat: 11am-1am
Sunday: 12 midday-11pm
Mon-Fri: 12 midday-3pm,

Sat & Sun: 12 midday-4pm
Our menu continues in the same theme with all the great pub favourites such as Beer Battered Fish & Chips, Bangers & Mash, Cheeseburgers and All Day Breakfast.
There is also a great wine list featuring wines from around the world with all the favourites for you to choose from. If you have a favourite beer, wine, spirit or food that we don't stock and would like it for your party or are a regular customer, let us know, we will do our best to arrange it for you.

Local Gluten Free Menus
Each of our pubs offer a wide range of gluten free dishes. Most of our sauces, gravies and dressings have been gluten free for many years. But we have been working with Coeliac UK in order to develop recipes for pastries, flapjacks, shortbreads and the like in order to offer more and more gluten free options.
We adopted Coeliac UK’s training for all of our Managers and Head Chefs along with our already robust training in order to give our teams the knowledge and confidence in this area and we are thrilled to have been awarded Coeliac UK’s accreditation.
Simply look out for two symbols next to dishes on our Daily Menu; gf – gluten free and gfa – which denotes a dish that could easily be adapted to make it gluten free if you ask your server.

Every year we run a competition across all of our pubs to crown creators of the best dishes. Each pub enters a junior chef and front of house partnership to represent them in our company wide competition to develop and reward our rising stars.
The idea of this task is to show that consistency, accuracy and replication need to be cornerstones of our food offer.
The second task gives each team free range to choose from an amazing larder of ingredients: guinea fowls, rabbits, pork and venison loins, lobsters, whole fish, racks of lamb (too many things to mention).
Each team has 3 hours to devise a main course and a pudding using their imagination and creativity. The challenge we set the teams was around simplicity of style, idea and presentation whilst keeping the dishes tasty and a good fit for our pubs and this ultimately decided our top three.
It’s fair to say that the 2026 finals brought with it a consistently high standard of cooking. It was especially pleasing to see how all the team’s balanced originality and innovation whilst keeping in mind our overall food style.

Dragon to the George
There has been a public house on this corner of St John Street for well over a century. The present building was rebuilt in 1889 to 1890 on the site of an earlier pub known as the Green Dragon, commissioned by owner W. Pierpoint, built by W.L. Kellaway to the designs of architect H.J. Newton, and roofed in by the spring of 1890.
By the 1980s it was trading as George & Dragon, and in recent years as the Peasant. We've kept the best of the old, the corner position, the tilework, the character, and brought the dragon's name back home.

The Robin is a family friendly, warm and welcoming pub, located close to the centre of Brentwood.
We are proud to offer a safe and inclusive atmosphere and environment to everyone that visits us. The pub has a rich and varied history, but has long stood as a centre of the community.
We offer an extensive menu and a wide range of beers, ales and spirits, wines and soft drinks.
We have a kids play area on Astroturf with a newly refurbished patio area.  We have a beer garden with covered areas for when it's warm and heaters for the chillier months, and we are also dog friendly.
We are open 7 days for for lunch, dinner or a quick snack and are open all day Sunday when we serve our “famous” traditional full roast dinner.
We often have evening entertainment including singers and bands, as well as Karaoke nights, and can provide a great venue for private celebrations including parties and celebrations and we also have rooms that cater for business meetings.
We regularly show live sporting events including both Sky and TNT Sports, we have a pub darts team even sponsor our local football teams.

Does The Hollywood Arms serve food?

Yes, our Boulevard Room is available for private hire, or our Aviary can be used for semi-private hire.
Does The Hollywood Arms do Christmas parties?

The French offers a warm welcome to friends and newcomers alike, together with a choice of thirty superb champagnes and wines by the glass.

the French House truly deserves its reputation as the best known pub in the world's naughtiest square mile. Its no music, no machines, no television and no mobile phones rule makes it a haven for conversationalists and a firm favourite among some of the best known names in showbusiness.

Welcome to The Argyll Arms, a historic pub in OXFORD CIRCUS
As a British brand with a heritage of 150+ years, we pride ourselves on our position as purveyors of perfect pints and unbeatable pies, with tempting dishes on our British pub classic menus.
A unique city centre pub with a rich history
Dating back to 1868, The Argyll Arms, was named after the second Duke of Argyll, who lived in a mansion where the Palladium now stands. At the time Victorian snug areas were built in to separate the social classes. Today though, everyone is welcome!
The Argyll Arms offers a fascinating social and historical narrative; rumour has it that a secret tunnel once connected the pub to the Duke’s mansion!

The Andover Arms x The Glasshouses
Saturday 12 September 2026
On 12 September we took the food, drink and hospitality of The Andover Arms to a very special corner of our neighbourhood: the beautiful glasshouses in Ravenscourt Park.
Hidden away amongst the gardens and not normally open to the public, the glasshouses are a magical setting. We gathered around long communal tables beneath the vines for an end-of-summer evening of wonderful food, drinks and good company.
The evening was a celebration of the brilliant work of Hammersmith Community Gardens Association (HCGA), who look after the glasshouses and do so much to bring people, nature and growing together within our community.
£10 from every ticket was donated directly to HCGA, and there was a silent auction during the evening with all proceeds supporting their work. ​
Harvest Festival
Love is Blind
During Valentine's Day, we hosted a blind tasting dinner in support of Guide Dogs UK, raising £2,500 for the charity.
The evening invited guests to experience food through touch, sound and scent, offering a glimpse into how blind and partially sighted people navigate the world. Developed with guide dog owner Dave Kent and our kitchen team, the event was intimate, moving and deeply memorable — for us and for everyone who took part.

A traditional, family-run pub in Richmond, The Sun Inn promises hearty home-cooked food, delicious drinks and live sport on TV inside and out. With the pub close to Twickenham, it's the perfect place for a pint after the rugby - or a sublime Sunday roast to round off the weekend.

The Sun Inn, Richmond
The Sun Inn's home-cooked classics offer some of the best-value pub food in Richmond, with authentic family recipes like ‘Joe's Homemade Steak Pie' among a menu of traditional favourites.
Lunch is served from noon, with Pie and Chips, Chilli Con Carne, Sweet Potato Chilli, Sausage & Mash & Gammon, Egg & Chips available for just £9.95 as part of our special weekday deal.

Local Gluten Free Menus
Each of our pubs offer a wide range of gluten free dishes. Most of our sauces, gravies and dressings have been gluten free for many years. But we have been working with Coeliac UK in order to develop recipes for pastries, flapjacks, shortbreads and the like in order to offer more and more gluten free options.
We adopted Coeliac UK’s training for all of our Managers and Head Chefs along with our already robust training in order to give our teams the knowledge and confidence in this area and we are thrilled to have been awarded Coeliac UK’s accreditation.
Simply look out for two symbols next to dishes on our Daily Menu; gf – gluten free and gfa – which denotes a dish that could easily be adapted to make it gluten free if you ask your server.

Every year we run a competition across all of our pubs to crown creators of the best dishes. Each pub enters a junior chef and front of house partnership to represent them in our company wide competition to develop and reward our rising stars.
The idea of this task is to show that consistency, accuracy and replication need to be cornerstones of our food offer.
The second task gives each team free range to choose from an amazing larder of ingredients: guinea fowls, rabbits, pork and venison loins, lobsters, whole fish, racks of lamb (too many things to mention).
Each team has 3 hours to devise a main course and a pudding using their imagination and creativity. The challenge we set the teams was around simplicity of style, idea and presentation whilst keeping the dishes tasty and a good fit for our pubs and this ultimately decided our top three.
It’s fair to say that the 2026 finals brought with it a consistently high standard of cooking. It was especially pleasing to see how all the team’s balanced originality and innovation whilst keeping in mind our overall food style.

The Spread Eagle Kitchen
The Spread Eagle runs a seasonal, minimal waste kitchen, working directly with foragers and local producers to bring you the best that British food has to offer. DRINKS
The Spread Eagle has rotating draught lines that are specially brewed without the addition of finings, making them not only natural, but deliciously tasty and 100% vegan. We also serve hand selected small batch wines that you would rarely find on a regular pub menu.

Plus our carefully curated cocktail list gives innovative vegan twists on the much loved classics,such as our infamous tequila sour using aquafaba as featured in the Guardian and Evening Standard.

After every game, you can access the encrypted seed and confirm that the outcome was generated fairly. This level of transparency is what distinguishes our verified platform from third-party sites and unofficial sources such as tribuna or other review portals.
Our game is fully licensed and regularly audited by independent testing agencies. The random number generation system undergoes periodic reviews, and the results are publicly available. Welcome to The Bear and Staff, a historic pub in LEICESTER SQUARE
As a British brand with a heritage of 150+ years, we pride ourselves on our position as purveyors of perfect pints and unbeatable pies, with tempting dishes on our British pub classic menus.
A unique city centre pub with a rich history
The Bear and Staff pub has stood here since 1714, the name coming from the crest of the Neville Family. The pub counts villains and celebrities in its considerable history. One landlord lost his licence on proof of Sunday trading and robbery! The current building, dating from 1878, was once frequented by Charlie Chaplin and our restaurant is named in his honour.

Real home cooked food in Epping Forest
Here at The Woodbine Pub & Restaurant in Epping Forest we offer a great range of classic pub style food served with a modern twist, taking inspiration from the seasons. Made from scratch in our kitchen
Everything on our menu is prepared fresh on site. From our homemade pies to our stone-baked pizzas, our kitchen team takes real pride in what lands on your plate. Our kitchen serves food Monday to Saturday until 9:00pm.
Drinks

We also have a great collection of single malts, sipping rums & tequilas, ports and liqueurs for after dinner treats.

Our Newest Residency: KAMU
KAMU embodies the heart and soul of Chef Deshan Warnasooriya’s culinary journey. Growing up Sri Lankan in Britain, Deshan enjoyed authentic Sri Lankan home cooking alongside inventive fusion dishes. Inspired by his mother’s rich culinary expertise, he learned how traditional Sri Lankan spices and techniques could be blended with flavours from around the world to create something truly special.
From these humble beginnings comes KAMU, a vibrant Sri Lankan kitchen that brings the warmth of our family table to yours. Our menu celebrates both cherished Sri Lankan classics and familiar favourites, each crafted with a distinctive Sri Lankan twist. Expect bold flavours, fresh ingredients and the genuine hospitality that lies at the heart of our heritage.

Signature smoked roats in Marylebone
Every Sunday from midday
Sundays are all about roasts done right at the Lord Wargrave. Our signature twist? We smoke our sirloin beef, chicken, and pork in-house, low and slow, for a flavour-packed feast you won’t find anywhere else in London. Paired with crispy roast potatoes, seasonal veg, and all the classic trimmings, it’s the ultimate Sunday indulgence.
We’re proud to work with independent, family-run butcher HG Walter, sourcing ethically raised meats from British and Irish farms. Our Hereford beef, reared in County Wexford and aged 28 days in a Himalayan salt chamber, is the star of the show.
Whether you’re a fan of beef, pork, chicken, or a vegan roast, Sundays at the Lord Wargrave are not to be missed. Book your table and make it a Sunday to remember!

Dalston’s legendary Cookes, reborn by exale brewing.
Exale Brewing has breathed new life into the iconic Grade II-listed Cooke’s Pie & Mash Shop on Kingsland Road, transforming this much-loved Dalston landmark into The Black Eel - a vibrant, multi-layered cultural and social destination that’s now firmly part of the neighbourhood.
Behind the preserved shopfront, the pub unfolds into a series of distinctive rooms: a buzzing main bar, games areas with darts and shuffleboard, karaoke, relaxed lounge spaces, and flexible hire zones - all designed with atmosphere and versatility in mind. Every corner offers something a little different.
Out back sits one of East London’s biggest hidden gems: a huge beer garden with tucked-away seating, space to celebrate, a boat and loads of greenery.
The Black Eel is your go-to spot for parties that feel easy, fun, and a bit different. Whether it’s a birthday, work do, or just a reason to get people together, we have a mix of spaces that can be tailored to your group size and vibe!
Expect a lively, social atmosphere with plenty to keep the energy going - from shuffleboard and darts to karaoke. With great drinks, food, and a buzzing setting, it’s built for good times that roll on into the night.

Built in 1839 on an old archery range, this pub quickly became a cherished neighbourhood meeting spot for residents looking to catch up with friends over a pint, and was frequented by notable locals throughout its history, from Winston Churchill to Tony Blair.
We are also thrilled to celebrate British winemakers through our unique wine list, largely sourced from vineyards in the English and Welsh countrysides, and supported by a few bold New World classics from the Commonwealth. Our bar offerings are equally as exciting, with classic cocktails on offer such as the bramble and the garden fizz, showcasing Scottish whiskeys and gin from the Cotswolds.
The cosy wood panelling and velvet furnishings amplify our relaxed and friendly atmosphere, making this the ideal retreat for after-work get togethers or a weekend treat with the family.
If you fancy a taste of the best of what Britain has to offer, our passionate and attentive team look forward to welcoming you to the neighbourhood's newest gem.

Christmas at The Stablehand
We're now taking Christmas bookings at The Stablehand!
Our warm and welcoming restaurant makes a fantastic venue for festive parties. We offer a three-course and a five-course British Christmas dinner with all the trimmings, and a range of drinks packages.
Enjoy a group meal in our sunny Garden Room, or head downstairs to the cosy, wood-panelled Wine Cellar. For a larger party, enquire about booking the full restaurant as your own private venue!
From classic fish and chips, to a hearty steak sarnie, lunch at The Stablehand is the perfect way to complete a stroll in Hyde Park or enjoy an al fresco lunch meeting.
Our lunch menu is available Monday to Saturday from 12pm – 5pm, at just £17.95 for two courses, or £20.95 for three courses.

Group Dining
With two beautifully furnished private dining rooms, The Stablehand is the perfect spot for your family or corporate event. Our wood-panelled Wine Cellar seats up to 26 guests, ideal for an intimate group lunch or dinner. Upstairs, the Garden Room is a bright and sunny space that seats up to 22.
We offer a delicious set menu and will happily adapt dishes to suit your group’s tastes, as well as suggest drinks to accompany your meal.

Built in 1787 the White Swan has always maintained its friendly, warm atmosphere within a beautiful location. Though located just moments from Richmond town centre there is still that feeling you’re off the beaten track.
Be it summer or winter you will feel right at home relaxing in our secluded sun-trap of a garden or warming yourselves around our open fires enjoying our award winning Sunday roasts – dogs more than welcome!

Did you know… St Stephen’s Tavern has been a Westminster institution since 1875? Nestled in the shadow of Big Ben, this historic pub has long been a favourite gathering spot for politicians, journalists, and locals, with its unique proximity to the Houses of Parliament. Even prime ministers like Baldwin, Churchill, and Macmillan have all graced its walls.
As a nod to its storied past, the pub still features its original division bell, used to alert MPs when a vote is imminent. Today, St Stephen’s Tavern proudly combines its rich heritage with modern hospitality, offering a warm and inviting retreat in the heart of London.
DISCOVER MORE

Delicious Pub Dining at St Stephen’s Tavern
At St Stephen’s Tavern, we proudly serve a classic dining experience steeped in tradition and flavour. Our menu features beloved pub favourites, from our iconic Fish & Chips to hearty pies and indulgent burgers, all crafted with fresh, high-quality ingredients.
Complement your meal with a perfectly poured pint of Badger or Outland beer, a fine wine, or a timeless spirit from our well-stocked bar. Whether you’re stopping in for a relaxed lunch, a post-work bite, or a catch-up with friends, St Stephen’s Tavern provides a cosy and welcoming retreat in the heart of Westminster.

Events at Westminster Abbey
Take a look at the special services, concerts, lectures, and events for families on offer at the beautiful Westminster Abbey – there’s something for everyone. Many events are free, and open to all. The Abbey is located just a short stroll from St Stephen’s Tavern, enjoy a traditional pub meal with us before or after your visit.

About Us
The Alma Arms is located in rural Navestock just a few miles away from Brentwood and Harold Hill. Just a short walk from the pub is Navestock’s Millennium Common which hold the Millennium Stone.
The Alma Arms has been well known for its Steak Pie and we continue this tradition on. Our Steak Pie uses British Beef cooked slowly for 12 hours and is the finest quality, locally sourced from our butcher who has been serving The Alma Arms with prime British Meats for 25 years.

Brett Graham has been a Director of the Harwood Arms since 2009. He is also the chef and restaurant owner of the 3 Michelin star The Ledbury.
Capability Graham is a farming and food company founded by Brett, providing exceptional ingredients whilst influencing positive change in the food industry. They provide specialist venison, Jersey beef, Iberian pork, charcuterie, and cold pressed rapeseed oil – all of which feature throughout the menu at the Harwood Arms.
Mike Robinson – Director
Mike runs two additional restaurants in the UK: The Elder in Bath and The Woodsman in Stratford Upon Avon. His company, Deer Box, provides wild venison to restaurants and offers home delivery. He also oversees 60,000 acres of land dedicated to deer management and produces three wild game TV shows annually for the Outdoor Channel.

Pub history
Spouters’ Corner has been accustomed to comings and goings for a very long time. The leisure complex occupies an open-air meeting place, hence its name, which was partly occupied by the blacksmith’s forge established by George Chesser in 1770. Chesser’s smithy served the passing trade on High Road and operated on this site into the 1920s.

East London smokehouse legends From The Ashes have taken over the kitchen here at Pub on the Park, serving up their signature bold, fire-cooked BBQ on London Fields. You might recognise them from their tenure at the Five Points Courtyard , or maybe from way back in 2022 when they were operating out of their hatch in Hackney Wick.
Expect slow-smoked meats , tacos that ooze with fresh flavour, sides that just keep coming (you've got to try the pulled pork fries, and those pickles ?!), plus a chicken burger that genuinely might change your life …
If meat's not for you, there are some seriously good veggie options bringing just as much flavour to the table, from that roasted aubergine to the simplicity burger, you're going to be just as impressed as the carnivores.
On Sundays , the roasts coming from the kitchen team are some of the best we've ever had here in our pub on the Fields, come by and try it for yourself. Perfect for a lazy Sunday with a glass of red or a pint of stout. Plus, if you fancy something lighter, their roast buns are great for your Sunday fix, or your hangover cure!
So whether you’re stopping by after a trip down Broadway Market via Colombia Road, or settling in for a few pints while you watch the footy, if you’re after standout BBQ in East London, From the Ashes has you covered.

It's a breeze!
To seal the deal for your epic celebration, just drop us a £10 deposit per person. And hey, if plans change, no sweat – you can snag that deposit back up to 7 days before the big day. Plus, you can pre-pay the rest of the party tab (including all those delicious nibbles and drinks) for a worry-free bash.
Can I host a party in your garden?
1000%. We love hosting legends in our beer garden, come rain or shine. If you are joining us on the weekend our Burger Shack will be open, serving up napkins at the ready, chin dribbling patties of perfection.
Quick heads-up: Our garden throws in the towel at 9 pm from Sunday to Thursday and 10 pm on Fridays and Saturdays. But don’t worry, we’ll make sure the fun doesn’t fizzle out before then.
Can I have a DJ or live music?
While we don't have a private space available, fear not – there's still a world of fun to be had. While we can't accommodate a DJ or live music, we're here to ensure your celebration is still jam-packed with good vibes.

All of the meat served across our 10 pubs and Heather Farm Café comes from Walton Meats, our local butcher who we've proudly worked with for years. They know our standards & meet them every delivery.
From Sunday roasts & carveries that draw regulars back every week, to the burgers & steaks enjoyed from our all-day menu, they're all supplied from the same great team! Supporting a business like Walton Meats is about quality, trust and knowing the people we buy from, which matters to us & our customers.
Silent Pool Gin
Edinburgh Gin
A brilliant, award-winning gin with a range that suits every palate. We stock Edinburgh Gin at all 10 pubs & Meade Hall including the classic London Dry and their seasonal specials. It's earned its spot on our shelves!
Alongside our gin partners, every pub carries a full range of real ales, wines, cocktails, and spirits. And if you're driving or just fancy something lighter, we've got low and no alcohol wines, beers, and our “Virtuous” cocktails at every bar.
What's on the menu
Our menus include pub classics alongside seasonal specials, updated at least every season. Veggie and vegan options sit alongside the meat dishes on every menu, and we offer NGCI (Non Gluten Containing Ingredients) choices too. If you've got a dietary need, let the team know and they'll look after you.
The children's menu is available for under 12s at every pub. It is a thought-through menu with choices they'll actually eat. Highchairs and baby changing are available at every site too.

Welcome to The Globe, a historic pub in MOORGATE
As a British brand with a heritage of 150+ years, we pride ourselves on our position as purveyors of perfect pints and unbeatable pies, with tempting dishes on our British pub classic menus.
A unique city centre pub with a rich history
Nicholson’s Pubs are known for their individual style, exciting stories, and charming personalities — and The Globe is certainly no exception.
With its elegant rococo exterior, you could call The Globe the social hub of both Moorgate and London Wall, and you wouldn’t be wrong. The building sits in a prominent position at the junction, running along the line of a Roman Wall. It’s also situated close to the original site of notorious Bedlam (Bethlem) Hospital for the enthusiasts of London’s rich and varied history and pub quiz masters.
There’s space for everyone to explore each room’s distinct and unique ambience and atmosphere.

The Fox is a family-run pub and restaurant, owned and lovingly run by husband and wife Paul & Gail Spencer, supported by a small team who share our passion for great food and warm hospitality.
Following the success of our first venture, Heathfield’s Café, we wanted to bring The Fox back to life and create somewhere that felt both special and genuinely local.
As Keston residents ourselves, being part of the community is at the heart of what we do.
Our Menu
We offer a wide variety of dishes to suit all tastes, including vegetarian and vegan options. Our gastropub menu changes seasonally to ensure we are always using the freshest ingredients available.
All of our dishes are freshly prepared in house, we even chip our own chips!
Where possible we try to support local suppliers and producers. We grow our own herbs in our beautiful garden which we use in our salads and dressings.
We also create weekly specials so that our menu is varied and ever changing.
Our Team
Jazz Nights
We are delighted to host Tuesday Jazz sessions performed by Harry & Elizabete a pair of very talented young musicians (and also our resident couple here at the Fox), inspired by a nostalgic blend of jazz, soul & folk.
Bringing the warm tones of jazz piano, acoustic guitar and duet vocals, they'll keep you smiling while you enjoy the lovely food and service on a Tuesday evening. (From 7.30pm)
Our 2026 Jazz dates to be announced soon.

Welcome to The Falcon, a historic pub in CLAPHAM JUNCTION
As a British brand with a heritage of 150+ years, we pride ourselves on our position as purveyors of perfect pints and unbeatable pies, with tempting dishes on our British pub classic menus.
A unique city centre pub with a rich history
Nicholson’s Pubs are known for their individual style, exciting stories, and charming personalities — and The Falcon is certainly no exception.
The Falcon is the perfect place to watch the match with friends. We’re equipped with spacious seating areas, and large screen TV’s showing Sky Sports and BT Sport, so you won’t miss a minute of the action, and can soak up a great atmosphere whilst you tuck into your favourite dishes, or enjoy a refreshing pint. On the weekends you can enjoy live music, in a fantastic friendly atmosphere.
Our stunning interiors were designed by artist MC Escher; most famous for his strange graphic works, depicting surreal and impossible perspectives. The Falcon stained glass window overlooking the bar, is part of the crest of the St John family and gives the bar its name.

Visit our relaxed and welcoming Thai restaurant in Hammersmith at Latymers, a pub on the outside, and a traditional Thai experience on the inside.
We offer a wide selection of Thai dishes in the heart of Hammersmith, cooked and served as they would be in Thailand. Our Thai cuisine is a harmonious blend of spicy, sour, sweet and salty, and our Tripadvisor reviews are glowing – calling us one of the best Thai Restaurants in Hammersmith!
From classic Pad Thai and Green Curry to our famous signature Thai dishes such as Weeping Tiger and Goong Pao, we have a huge Thai food menu that will be sure to exceed your expectations and keep you coming back for more.
For more than a quarter of a century, Latymers has been the place to go for a top Thai meal in Hammersmith. There are over 30 tempting dishes to choose from here - with the food so authentic we've even cooked for the Thai Embassy in recent years.
Alongside the main menu, Head Chef Tyson and his team also offer an express lunch menu, perfect when you're pushed for time. Delicious Thai dishes, on the table in as little as five minutes!
View our Thai lunch and dinner menus on this page and book a table or simply drop in when you have a craving for authentic Thai.

Seouls of Mischief at The Adam & Eve, Homerton
We are delighted to welcome Seouls of Mischief , the burger-led sister concept from multiple award-winning restaurant Mexican Seoul, as our new kitchen residency. You will find us on Homerton High Street in Hackney, three minutes on foot from Homerton Overground on the Mildmay line, and an easy walk from Hackney Wick, Chatsworth Road and Clapton.
Korean burgers and award-winning wings in Homerton
Since opening, Mexican Seoul has built a loyal following for its Korean-Mexican cooking. The Infatuation called its wings “some of our favourite wings in London”. The Hackney Citizen praised their tacos as being “cooked with patience and precision”.
What is on the opening menu
With an opening menu leading on the greatest hits dishes that built their name, Seouls of Mischief are bringing you their award winning wings alongside their burgers and sides, perfect for a classic pub like The Adam and Eve.
Cocktails to match
The food arrives with a drinks list to match. Five cocktails inspired by the Seouls of Mischief's menu, with flavours ranging from the classic Tommy's Margarita, to the team's favourite, the Solero, to a Kimchi Bloody Maria available only on Saturdays and Sundays, to complement your weekend feasting.
Kitchen times and how to find us
The kitchen serves Monday to Friday 5pm to 10pm, Saturday midday to 10pm and Sunday midday to 6pm. We are at 155 Homerton High Street, London E9 6AS, three minutes from Homerton station. Walk-ins are always welcome, but the weekend fills up.

Welcome to The Elm Tree, Surbiton
The Elm Tree is one of Surbiton's favourite destinations for live sport, live music, great food, and exceptional drinks. Located on the bustling Surbiton High Street , just three minutes from Surbiton Station with fast, direct links to London Waterloo, we're proud to be at the heart of the local community.
Whether you're joining us for the biggest match, an evening of live music, a family Sunday lunch, or simply a drink with friends , there's always something happening at The Elm Tree.
We're passionate about great beer , and our Guinness is poured the traditional way from authentic Irish taps , earning a reputation as one of the best pints of the famous Irish stout in the area. Alongside a carefully selected range of beers, wines, spirits and cocktails, you'll always find something worth raising a glass to.
For live sport fans, we show all the action across Sky Sports, TNT Sports and Premier Sports on six big-screen TVs , making The Elm Tree one of Surbiton's go-to venues for watching everything from Premier League football and rugby to Formula 1, boxing and more.
Our residency kitchen, Pretty Boy Tacos, brings bold, flavour-packed Mexican-inspired street food to The Elm Tree throughout the week. Every Sunday, they put their own spin on a British classic with a Latin-inspired Sunday roast , combining traditional favourites with vibrant flavours that have quickly become a local favourite.
From packed match days and lively music nights to relaxed afternoons and memorable celebrations, The Elm Tree offers a warm, welcoming atmosphere for every occasion. Whether you're meeting friends, hosting a special event, bringing the family together, or escaping the home office for a few hours, you'll always find a friendly face and a great atmosphere waiting for you.

Legendary for free live music several nights a week, The Pelton has built a reputation for unforgettable nights and great atmosphere. It even appeared as the "Nag's Head" in Rock & Chips, the prequel to Only Fools and Horses.
Bringing together historic character, great food and drink, with the warm welcome of a true local.

Welcome to The Clarence, a historic pub in MAYFAIR
As a British brand with a heritage of 150+ years, we pride ourselves on our position as purveyors of perfect pints and unbeatable pies, with tempting dishes on our British pub classic menus.
BOOK NOW TO BE THE FIRST TO EXPERIENCE THE NEW CLARENCE
Based near the epicentre of London’s 1960s counterculture scene, nearby you’ll find an abundance of Central London’s most iconic attractions — including The Royal Academy of Arts, The London Palladium, The Photographers’ Gallery and plenty beautiful gardens; Green Park, Berkeley Square Gardens, Cavendish Square Gardens and Soho Square Gardens.
It’s the perfect spot to catch up with friends, relax with family, indulge in some after work drinks with colleagues, and generally to enjoy the finer things in life in our unique and historic surroundings. Our team are on hand to help if you wish to speak to someone about booking large group bookings, parties and events, as well as arranging private room hire for those special occasions.
A unique city centre pub with a rich history
Nicholson’s Pubs are known for their individual style, exciting stories, and charming personalities — and The Clarence is certainly no exception.
The Clarence in Mayfair offers a welcoming retreat near you in the heart of London, with views overlooking The Ritz. Our pub offers fine hospitality, a great ale selection and speciality food.
Named after the Duke of Clarence, who later became King William IV, our location on Dover Street marks where Sir Alexander Bell's first successful telephone call was made. Dover Street also boasts a long line of famous residents, including 18th century poet Alexander Pope, Buckingham Palace architect John Nash and Polish composer Frederic Chopin.

What does The Bell On The Green offer?
The Bell On The Green offers Indian food, British pub classics, drinks, set menus, a beer garden, a games room and private event catering near Heathrow. The venue is suitable for casual dining, family meals, social gatherings and special occasions.
Who Is The Bell On The Green For?
Yes, you can book a table at The Bell On The Green. Table bookings are suitable for couples, families, individuals and groups planning to dine at the venue.
Does The Bell On The Green Offer Catering?
Yes, The Bell On The Green offers catering and event spaces for private occasions. Catering is available for events such as weddings, birthdays, parties and family gatherings.
Is The Bell On The Green Suitable for Families?
Yes, The Bell On The Green is suitable for families. Guests can enjoy the varied menu, relaxed environment, beer garden and games room.
Does The Bell On The Green offer set menus?
Yes, The Bell On The Green offers set menu options. These provide guests with curated dining choices.
Can I organise a party at The Bell On The Green?
Yes, The Bell On The Green provides event spaces and catering for parties. The venue also caters for birthdays, weddings and family gatherings.
Does The Bell On The Green offer wedding catering?
Yes, catering is available for weddings and other private celebrations. Customers can contact the venue to discuss their event requirements.

The Bell On The Green is a British pub and Indian restaurant near Heathrow offering Indian cuisine, British pub food, drinks, family dining, a beer garden, games room facilities and private event catering. The Nelson's is a classic East London boozer based off Hackney Road. it's been a pub for nearly 200 years (Est. 1825!).The most recent owners; Ben Todd, Marc Stagg, and James Mitchell have ran venues and events in the bar industry for years.
Their ethos is to keep independent venues successful and operating, less we loose them! Sunday is a highly recommended day to visit. We make an awesome Sunday Roast and the iconic Columbia Road Flower Market is a stones throw away. We love hosting celebrations — from laid-back birthdays to stunning wedding receptions — Food and drink packages to suit all tastes, and a dedicated team who'll make organising your event easy.
Will I need to pay a deposit?
To secure the semi-private areas, we require a £350 non-refundable deposit. This deposit is fully redeemable towards your minimum spend, whether that be a pre-order or using it as a bar tab on the day.
What is your cancellation or rescheduling policy?
Our deposits are non-refundable, but if you provide us with two weeks' notice in writing that you need to reschedule your event, we can move the deposit to a new date. All new dates are subject to availability.
Do you offer food and drink packages?
We offer a variety of drinks and food packages that cater to every style of event, from formal meals to casual drinks and canapes. We update our menus and fabulous event packages seasonally, so if your event is later in the year, please use these as a reference only for the time being.
Are dietary requirements accommodated?
Can we bring our own DJ, band, or performers?
We have our own fabulous resident DJs that play from 20:30-00:30 every Friday & Saturday evening. Unfortunately, we do not allow any live music or external entertainment in the semi-private spaces.

Discover the Story of The Old Ship Richmond
Where is The Old Ship Richmond?
You’ll find The Old Ship at 3 King Street, Richmond, London, TW9 1ND, in the heart of Richmond town centre. We’re ideally placed for shopping, exploring Richmond, heading towards the Thames or meeting for food and drinks before a big day out.
What is the closest station to The Old Ship Richmond?
Richmond Station is the closest station to The Old Ship and is around a five-minute walk from the pub. The station offers National Rail, London Underground District line and London Overground services, making us easy to reach from across London.
Is The Old Ship Richmond dog friendly?
Yes. The Old Ship is a dog-friendly pub, so four-legged friends are very welcome to join you. It’s an especially handy stop after exploring Richmond or taking a winter walk nearby.
Does The Old Ship Richmond have private hire spaces?
Yes. Our upstairs private and semi-private spaces are ideal for birthdays, Christmas parties, meetings, celebrations and private sports screenings. They offer flexible layouts for seated or standing events, with screens available too.

Welcome to The Clachan, a historic pub in SOHO
As a British brand with a heritage of 150+ years, we pride ourselves on our position as purveyors of perfect pints and unbeatable pies, with tempting dishes on our British pub classic menus.
A unique city centre pub with a rich history
Nicholson’s pubs are known for their individual style, exciting stories, and charming personalities - and The Clachan is certainly no exception.
Built in 1898, this local pub boasts many of its original Victorian features, including rich wood carvings and structural ironwork. Our pub served as the local for the firemen of Station No.12 and the police officers of the Special Constable Reserve in King Street.
The Clachan is a great spot to catch up with friends, relax with family, chat with colleagues, and generally enjoy the finer things in life.

Welcome to The King's Head
Sunday Roasts There’s a reason Sundays are our busiest, most roast-hungry days, and it’s not just the giant, gravy-soaking Yorkshire puddings (though they definitely help). We’re talking slow-roasted, top-quality British cuts, ever-changing, peak-of-the-season veg, and all the proper Sunday trimmings (crispy, golden, pile-your-plate-high stuff).
Roast With Us
Christmas Parties in Putney Planning a Christmas party in Putney? Think hearty festive menus, mulled wine by the fire, just-pulled pints and cosy, twinkly spaces made for work dos, family feasts and festive catch-ups. At The King’s Head, SW15, you’ll find warm hospitality, old-school pub charm and everything you need for a properly memorable Christmas celebration.
Tucked just a stone’s throw from Richmond Park, Putney Heath, Roehampton Uni and Queen Mary’s Hospital, we reckon you won’t find a better spot for a bite and a winter tipple this side of SW15. And honestly, with our covered and heated beer garden  and big, bring-the-whole-gang dining room, why would you want to go anywhere else?
Our Sunday roasts are the stuff of local legend (crispy, golden, gravy-drenched dreams), and our fresh, British, seasonal menu is served all day, every day, just how it should be.
Looking to host an event or celebration?  Take a peek here at our semi-private spaces .

We honestly can’t think of a single special occasion where we shouldn’t be top of your list, birthday blowouts, buttoned-up work meetings, long-overdue catch-ups (or those wonderfully flimsy excuses to get the gang back together).
From light-filled lounges to cosy, corner-hugging snugs, one of our ready-to-party, easy-to-book spaces is bound to be just the ticket.

A traditional family-run, dog & family friendly, classic car-centric, riverside live music pub boasting a sun-soaked beer terrace in the heart of Brentford,
West London.
Under new management of The McCormack Family since December 2019, The Brewery Tap has undergone a sympathetic (but much needed!) renovation to restore this lively local watering hole back to it's traditional former glory.
Located just off Brentford High Street, The Brewery Tap offers a unique and vibrant atmosphere that acts as a place for friends, wanderers, artistes, musicians, families and car enthusiasts alike to share their love of live music and enjoy drinks, fantastic pizzas and
good times together.
With a varied live music schedule - promising much-loved bands and artistes every week -
you can enjoy everything from jazz, rock, folk, soul, Irish and more.

As a British brand with a heritage of 150+ years, we pride ourselves on our position as purveyors of perfect pints and unbeatable pies, with tempting dishes on our British pub classic menus.
A unique city centre pub with a rich history
The site of our pub was an ambulance station at the beginning of the 20th Century, but its place in history was secured when one of the first electric ambulances was stationed here in 1909. At night time and Sundays this one vehicle served the entire city. We are just off Bishopsgate, a street named after the Bishop's Gate, which stood opposite Camomile Street.

Welcome to The Three Greyhounds, a historic pub in SOHO
As a British brand with a heritage of 150+ years, we pride ourselves on our position as purveyors of perfect pints and unbeatable pies, with tempting dishes on our British pub classic menus.
An exciting transformation is taking shape at The Three Greyhounds in Soho. We’re currently closed for refurbishment and will reopen on the 19th November. Book now to be among the first back through the doors.

The Gladwin Brothers pay tribute to their early days, when they enjoyed crisp pints of beer at this very spot, by taking over The Pig's Ear. The pub focuses on locally sourced produce, and seasonal dishes paired with a fantastic selection of beers, cocktails, and wines from the family vineyard in Nutbourne.
Nestled on Old Church Street, The Pig's Ear is a countryside-style pub that offers the perfect setting for locals to come together and enjoy community events, such as our Flying Pigs Run Club, cocktail masterclasses, and more. Lazy Sundays are for generous roasts, featuring livestock from West Sussex, delicious trimmings and crispy potatoes.
Whether you're savouring a pie and a pint by the fireplace or enjoying fresh seafood at our oyster station, The Pig's Ear is where guests become friends.

At The Joiner on Worship, we’re more than just a pub —we’re a three-floor sanctuary where traditional Irish hospitality meets a vibrant, queer energy. Whether you’re here for a quiet stout, a burger, or a sing-song with our weekly Live Music, the atmosphere is always grand.
The fun doesn’t stop at the bar; challenge your mates to Free Shuffleboard, hit the Beer Pong table, or grab a keepsake in our Photo Booth. Planning something bigger? Our huge upstairs function room features a private bar, offering a premium, versatile space perfect for corporate parties and private events.
Our name is a tribute to the craftsmanship of 1860. This building began its life as a furniture warehouse for the legendary Moore and Hunton. Today, we pay homage to the skilled joiners who once worked these floors. Just as they crafted quality furniture, we’re here to craft quality experiences—one pint, one song, and one party at a time.

The bank manager's office is now a snug – book it for a special occasion or pop in for a game of darts; board games are also aplenty.
Unless you'd prefer to sit back and enjoy our garden , of course.

SW London's No.1 Music Venue
If you love live music, chances are you’ve heard of us! We are the Half Moon, a much-loved Putney pub and iconic music venue since the 1960s. With greatest hits including U2’s first sellout UK gig, KD Lang’s first UK appearance and Kate Bush’s first public show, we’re proud to be a part of Putney history.
Set in the heart of Putney, just by Putney Bridge and the Thames, our stage is open to artists every night of the week, with our regular New Moon Monday showcasing the best of up-and-coming acts from around the globe.
Whether you’re joining us for a pre-gig bite or getting the pals together for a laid-back dinner, you’re sure to find your new favourite dish on our Americana-inspired menu. Planning a party? Check out our private space upstairs, perfect for any occasion from big birthday bashes to corporate meetings.

London is full of iconic buildings, and we’re pretty confident when we say that the Lord Napier Star is certainly the focal point of Hackney Wick, and has been for decades.
We’re the only pub in Hackney Wick, and  we’re pretty hard to miss, we’re the one covered in graffiti.
We're incredibly proud to host some of London's most delicious and creative food traders. Our current guest kitchen is Oh My Dog!, known for their legendary hot dogs and more. Plus we offer a legendary selection of beers, wines, spirits and cocktails.

Food @The Antwerp Arms
Our latest pop up is The Roast Spot, operating Tuesday-Sunday.
In 2021, Teon followed his passion for cooking and founded The Roast Spot. What began as a love for creating delicious, home-style food has grown into a thriving business with a loyal customer base and strong support from the local community.
As a self-taught chef, Teon has built The Roast Spot through hard work, determination and a commitment to quality. Every meal is prepared with care, bringing people together over great food and exceptional service.
The vision for The Roast Spot goes beyond serving outstanding food. Teon is passionate about creating opportunities for others by providing employment, work experience and training for young people. By investing in the next generation, The Roast Spot aims to help build confidence, develop valuable skills and inspire future careers within the hospitality industry.
At The Roast Spot, we're proud to be more than just a place to eat—we're a business rooted in community, opportunity, and a passion for great food.

Prospectus for a New Food Operator
Ready, Chef, go! We would like to hear from companies or individuals interested in operating a food offering at the pub.
Background
The Antwerp Arms is a community pub owned by 460 shareholders and operated by an elected managing committee, The Antwerp Arms Association. We are a comfortable, community centred space seating 60, with a small covered garden at the rear. We're open Tuesday - Sunday, opening from 12pm at weekends.
The managing committee lets the bar operations to RBC Pubs Ltd under the management of Andy and Sam. This includes the provision of food from the pub kitchen. Bar services are managed by pub managers on a day to day basis.
We continue to invest in the pub, installing air conditioning, refurbishing the space and providing a diverse programme of entertainment which includes live music and DJs.
The opportunity
Our wet sales have increased by 15% over the last two years, and now we're excited to expand our food offer. We currently have installed YardSale pizza as a temporary food option but are eager to develop our range with a dedicated company or individual to run the kitchen.
The average turnover per month for the last kitchen operator was £7000 but ranges from £4500 - £12000. Annual turnover for the proposed kitchen operator could be £80,000
The majority of food trade takes place Friday, Saturday and Sunday, with Sunday lunches being popular.

One of the oldest and most historic pubs in London, The Lamb has been at the heart of Bloomsbury for centuries. Famed for its rich literary past, the pub once welcomed the likes of Sylvia Plath as a regular, alongside visits from Charles Dickens, all adding to the timeless character that still fills every corner today.
Located between Holborn and Russell Square stations on the charming Lamb’s Conduit Street, The Lamb is a proper Victorian pub known for legendary Sunday roasts in Bloomsbury, perfectly poured cask ales, craft beers, full-bodied wines and seasonal British dishes made with the very best produce.
Book a table View the menus Plan a party
Food & Drinks
Our menus are a celebration of the great British pub – comforting classics, generous plates and the sort of food best enjoyed over good conversation and a well-poured pint. Think homemade scotch eggs and sausage rolls fresh from the kitchen, proper pies, classic fish & chips and the kind of hearty dishes that seem made for settling into an old pub booth for the afternoon.
Sundays, naturally, are something of an institution around here. Our famed roasts have become a Bloomsbury favourite, with towering Yorkshire puddings, plenty of proper gravy and our much-loved sharing roast made for long, lazy afternoons with friends.
Behind the bar, you’ll find well-kept beers and real ales with rotating guest lines, alongside classic cocktails and a thoughtfully chosen wine list from around the world – all ready for whatever sort of visit you fancy, from a quick pint to a wonderfully drawn-out evening.

Traditional pub food at it's finest
From our bar snacks to our Sunday roasts and all that’s in between, our team of chefs use the best of Britain’s produce to bring you our classic pub food.
With a cellar full of the best local beers and real ales, and a back bar stocked with the finest worldy-wines and spirits, you’ll struggle to find a more traditional London pub.

What is NGCI, and why not just say gluten-free?
NGCI means No Gluten Containing Ingredients. "Gluten-free" is a regulated term meaning the food has been verified below 20 parts per million, which needs a separate preparation area we do not have. NGCI is the honest description of what we can offer.
What NGCI dishes are currently listed?
Our kitchen flags Chunky Chips and Sweet Potato Fries as NGCI. Our stone-baked pizzas can be made on an NGCI base on request. Everything is prepared in one kitchen, so we can't guarantee there's no cross-contamination.
Do you offer gluten free fish and chips?
We do not offer NGCI (No Gluten Containing Ingredients) fish and chips. There is no NGCI batter, no NGCI fried or grilled fish, and no separate fryer. Please see our NGCI menu or ask the team about allergens before ordering.

Bag O'Nails, London
Our highly-rated Grade II listed pub Bag O'Nails, shares a road name with one of, if not the most visited English building in the country: Buckingham Palace. Situated less than a ten minute walk from the home of the British monarchy, thousands of tourists fly to London every year to see the royal gems London Victoria has to offer.
For art lovers and archaeological aficionados, the Victoria & Albert Museum and Natural History Museum are just a few train stops away. Or, if you'd prefer to take a breath away from the concrete of the city, St James' Park, Hyde Park and Green Park are right on the doorstep of our pub.

Welcome to Toby Carvery Snaresbrook
Looking for a delicious carvery restaurant in London? Toby Carvery Snaresbrook is the perfect place to enjoy a traditional roast dinner with family and friends. We’ve spent over 40 years serving the Great British roast, earning our reputation as the Home of the Roast since 1985.
Whether you’re joining us for a traditional Sunday roast, a midweek carvery or celebrating a special occasion, you’ll always find great food, generous portions and a warm welcome
More Than Just a Carvery in London
There’s more to Toby Carvery Snaresbrook than our famous roast dinners. Whether you call it a Full English or a cooked breakfast, our unlimited all-you-can-eat breakfast has everything you need to start the day right.
Alongside our carvery, we serve vegetarian and vegan dishes, a dedicated children’s menu and a range of beers, ciders, wines, spirits and hot drinks. Whether you’re catching up over lunch, enjoying an evening meal with the family or celebrating a special occasion, there’s something to suit every appetite.
Why Toby Carvery Snaresbrook?
At Toby Carvery Snaresbrook, we believe a great roast starts long before it’s served. That’s why our chefs are in the kitchen from the early hours every morning, carefully preparing every ingredient for the day ahead.
Our succulent joints of meat are slow-cooked to perfection, our potatoes are freshly roasted, and our famous wonky Yorkies are baked until they’re golden and crisp. Alongside freshly prepared vegetables and rich gravy, it’s all part of the care and attention that goes into every plate.
Whether it’s a Sunday roast or a midweek carvery, Toby Carvery Snaresbrook is ready and waiting. It’s this dedication to quality and tradition that’s made Toby Carvery the Home of the Roast for more than 40 years.
With a warm welcome from our friendly staff, inviting interiors and an exciting choice of menus, at Toby Carvery Snaresbrook, we serve up proper roasts with all the trimmings, every day of the week.

That’s why our chefs are in the kitchen bright and early every morning, preparing every ingredient with care and dedication. From preparing the vegetables to ensuring all our meat joints cook slowly for perfect flavour and tenderness, they work hard to bring you the roast you love.

Pub history
Several Wetherspoon pubs have ‘moon’ in their name, linking them with the ideal pub described by George Orwell. The famous author called his fictitious pub ‘Moon Under Water’.
This pub occupies a three-storey building which was a long-time grocer’s, then an annexe of Allders department store. It was built in the 1930s on the site of Sutton’s first hospital – which opened in 1902 and was paid for by John Passsmore Edwards.

A traditional British pub in Bethnal Green, East London
Located smack in the centre of the exuberant Columbia Road, The Royal Oak is Bethnal Green’s best-loved pub. With its bustling flower market on Sunday, it’s everyone’s favourite place to duck into to escape the big crowds.
Do we seem familiar? Thanks to the cool, worn-out features dating back to 1923, this cool East London boozer has been used as a filming location for a number of TV series and movie scenes, so you may know us from both Kray twins films or the 90’s sitcom Goodnight Sweetheart!
The original interior and our awesome team both add to the homely feel, making us your snug neighbourhood hangout and family go-to. While the downstairs bar is a hive of activity, upstairs offers the best Sunday roast in Shoreditch, and only the best of British classics. Expect no-nonsense pub grub and an impressive selection on the beer front.

The fires are lit, the lights are twinkling and the kitchen's already dreaming up something special. Christmas is coming to The Black Horse, and you're invited.
This December, swap the stress for a seat at our table. Long lunches that turn into evenings, catch-ups that are well overdue, and that one meal a year where nobody has to do the washing up. Whatever you're celebrating, and whoever you're celebrating with, we'll make it feel like Christmas from the moment you walk through the door.
Celebrating With a Group?

Enquire today and discover all the magical touches we can add to your Christmas. For any questions, we're just a message away!

Filming at the Black Horse
The Black Horse , we take pride in being one of the most film-friendly venues in the region. Over the years, we've built a strong reputation for welcoming film and television crews, offering a unique setting that blends character, charm, and versatility.
Why Choose The Black Horse for Your Shoot?
Authentic Atmosphere: With its classic architecture and timeless interiors, The Black Horse provides a backdrop that suits period dramas, contemporary stories, and everything in between.
Flexible Spaces: Whether you need a cosy pub setting, outdoor scenes, or adaptable areas for equipment and crew, we offer spaces that meet diverse production needs.
Film-Friendly Approach: We understand the demands of filming schedules and work closely with production teams to ensure smooth operations. Our staff are experienced in accommodating crews and maintaining a professional yet welcoming environment.
Convenient Location: Situated in a well-connected area, The Black Horse offers easy access for cast, crew, and equipment transport.

Three floors of fun? You bet. Whether you’re sinking pints in the buzzing ground-floor pub, sipping cocktails on our heated roof terrace, or getting a little fancy in the private dining room upstairs — we’ve got your vibe covered.
We’re talking seasonal menus that slap, Sunday roasts worth booking ahead for, and bar snacks worth writing home about. Add in banging craft beers, proper wines, and cheeky cocktails? You’re not just going out — you’re going out-out.

When he eventually made it home, he returned with more than just memories, but a mission to challenge the UK’s perception of Mexican food. No more bland fajita kits or processed shortcuts, just real, hearty dishes made with fresh ingredients and deep flavour, representing the region’s rich history, traditions, and culture.
This dream became a reality with a small stall on Brick Lane, where Dead Pedro’s quickly built a following and became a Sunday market favourite. The need for a permanent kitchen became clear and Pete soon found a forever home at the nearby Bow Bells Pub who happened to be looking for a new chef to serve their hungry regulars.
Today, Dead Pedro’s is a proud part of the local food scene, serving authentic Mexican flavours from an historic, much loved East End pub in the heart of Bow. The kitchen is open everyday at 5pm and 3pm on the weekends!

Pub history
Numbers 47 and 49 High Street were originally two long-standing shops – part of a parade built in late Victorian times. From c1900 until World War II, no.47 was Eastman’s drying and cleaning business. For many years, no.49 was occupied by a succession of high-class tailors. It was here that a tailor’s chalk was used to mark seams, showing where fabric needed to be cut or garments altered.

SMOK’D at The Grey Horse
Previously known as BBQWhiskyBeer back in our pop-up days, we have continued to cook using smokers , a charcoal oven and over fire on a grill. The menu takes influence from barbecue all over the world, smoking , roasting , charring and grilling , inspired by the smoked meats of great American pit masters; but cooked with a Modern British touch.
Alongside the barbecue we are renowned for our incredible burgers - particularly our Burger of the Month (BOTM) which, as you can guess, changes every month. We also offer vegetarian and vegan options for our barbecue and burgers, and have incredible value mid-week offers to tempt you out on a Monday night!
As you would expect we have a wide range of wines to suit all tastes and budgets and as well as a top selection draught keg craft beers and lager and our cask offerings, we also have a carefully selected choice of craft bottles and cans - perfect on their own, or with a delicious plate of ribs!
Our whisky (and whiskey!) selection is what really set us apart. We have the largest collection of single malt whiskies in London - be sure to check out the list above and call in for a nip. With such a vast selection, if you aren’t sure what to go for, don’t panic, our staff will be able to help you pick out a few to try.
